summary: xAI added a /goal command to Grok Build that lets the coding agent plan, execute and verify long-running tasks autonomously, with commands to monitor, pause and resume the work.

mechanisms.reason: The feature shifts coding work from back-and-forth human-driven sessions to autonomous agent execution of a delegated goal.
mechanisms.quote: With /goal , the agent continues until a task is completed and verified, whether that means reviewing code, inspecting webpages, or executing scripts.

practices.reason: Describes an agent scaffolding pattern (goal decomposition into a checklist, pause/resume control) an engineering team could observe or later adopt for their own agent loops.
practices.quote: It plans an approach, breaks the work into a progress checklist, and starts executing.
